Class UIRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.UIRegistry
public final class UIRegistry extends Object
Tells Offscreen how to draw and handle input for each screen type. Register a function that creates a HostUI for your screen; HostUIFactory is the API name for that function.

Resolution walks the screen's class hierarchy from concrete → root, returning the first registered match (nearest superclass). Interfaces are not searched. If several registrations name the same type, the earliest wins, even if its factory returns null.

Register and query on the client thread. This mutable list is not synchronized. Registrations retain their classes and factories until removed.

    • scoped

      public static <T, H extends HostUI> AutoCloseable scoped(Class<T> screenType, HostUIFactory<H> factory)
      Registers one screen-to-adapter rule and returns a handle for removing that rule. Closing the handle leaves other registrations alone, even if the same class and function were registered twice. It does not close existing windows.
      Type Parameters:
      T - screen class
      H - adapter type
      Parameters:
      screenType - concrete class or superclass
      factory - fresh adapter factory
      Returns:
      handle to close on the client thread when this rule is no longer needed; repeated closure is harmless

    • resolve

      @Nullable public static HostUI resolve(Object screen)
      Builds an adapter without opening a native window.

      Exact class matches beat superclass matches regardless of insertion order. Object is not considered during superclass traversal. Once a matching rule is found, its result is final: null does not trigger another factory. Factory exceptions propagate; created adapters are not cached here.

      Parameters:
      screen - screen instance, or null to return null immediately
      Returns:
      selected factory's result, or null when no registration matches

      public static boolean unregister(Class<?> screenType)

      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • clear

      public static void clear()
      Removes all rules, including the built-in vanilla and integration adapters. Intended for controlled setup. Addons should normally unregister only their own types. Existing windows are neither closed nor re-adapted.
